objective: Convert the accepted 77-name P2A Research Longlist into a security-type-aware, evidence-controlled research-enrichment queue without fabricating missing research or mutating any Candidate, portfolio, order, or trade authority state.

dimensions.minimum_evidence_standard: Issuer/exchange/regulatory primary evidence preferred; credible secondary evidence may supplement but not replace material primary facts.

security_type_notes.BANK: Use bank-specific capital, asset-quality, provisioning, funding, related-party and governance lenses; do not apply industrial leverage heuristics mechanically.
security_type_notes.INSURANCE: Use solvency, reserve/asset-liability, investment-book, distribution and governance lenses.
security_type_notes.SECURITIES_AND_BROKERAGE: Use capital, leverage, proprietary-book, counterparty, regulatory and governance lenses.
security_type_notes.GENERAL_NON_FINANCIAL: Use ownership/control, related parties, capital allocation, balance sheet, cash conversion, accounting quality and structural value-trap lenses.

dimensions.minimum_evidence_standard: Use dated consensus/management guidance/results evidence. If reliable revision data is unavailable, remain DATA_UNAVAILABLE/RESEARCH_REQUIRED rather than proxying from trailing growth.
Catalyst must be dated, security-specific and falsifiable; generic thematic narratives do not qualify.
Use current Southbound/HKEX/exchange/broker fee and tax rules with explicit effective dates. Portfolio-size assumptions belong downstream and may not be invented here.

Require evidence that the Hong Kong security and A-share are share classes of the same issuer plus synchronized prices/FX and comparable per-share rights. Parent/subsidiary or merely related A-share listings are NOT_APPLICABLE.
